notes.title: Maintenance notice on May 23
notes.content:
The whole server will be maintained from 10:00 to 12:00 on Thursday, May 23. You can't log in to the game during the maintenance process. Please inform each other.
After the maintenance on May 23, the "Xiaoman Activity" started. The Xiaoman card bag of this tavern can be drawn: Shen Guansuo, Shen Cai Wenji, Shen Yuan Shao. The Nirvana card pack can draw powerful demon generals: Mo Zhao Yu, Mo Xun Yu.
The new server S354 will be opened at 10 a.m. on Saturday, May 18.
After maintenance on May 23, the new Treasure Pavilion system will be opened! After collecting a certain amount of fragments, the complete treasure can be synthesized. Once the treasure is activated, it can improve the attributes of all generals and improve the combat effectiveness in an all-round way!
Treasure Pavilion System Entrance: Click the "More" button on the main interface to add the "Treasure" menu button, and click to enter.
Treasure Pavilion Activation Limit: Taishou Mansion reaches level 10 activation.
Access to the treasure:
1. Explore and obtain the Treasure Pavilion.
2. Merit Mall uses merit exchange to obtain purple quality "Yuan Shu General Soul Fragments", which is the only output of Merit Mall.
3. Honor Mall uses honor exchange to obtain the purple quality "Dianwei General Soul Fragment", which is the only output of Honor Mall.
4. Tiger Rune Mall uses Tiger Run to exchange to obtain orange-quality "Black Dragon City Fragments". This holy land is the only output of Tiger Run Mall.
5. Qunyingling can obtain orange-quality "green ancient view fragments" after completing the task. This holy place of the city is the only output of Qunyingling.
Exploration instructions of Treasure Pavilion:
You can explore for free once a day, or you can use the exploration order to continue to explore.
The exploration order can be obtained through the following channels:
1. Exchange and acquisition of holiday activities;
2. Exchange and acquisition in the alliance store;
3. Upgrade and obtain the group of heroes;
4. Buy a daily gift package to get it;
5. Complete the acquisition of treasure achievements.
Treasure Achievement Description: In the new achievement system, players can get rich achievement rewards by completing a series of treasure achievements. The Treasure Achievement Season is not reset and can only be completed once.
Treasure appearance description:
While activating the treasure, you can get the gorgeous appearance of the city, and the appearance of the marching generals can be freely replaced.
The appearance of the city can be used directly in the details page of the activated city sanctuary on the interface of the Treasure Pavilion.
The appearance of the march can enter the barracks, and the appearance of the march can be set in the troop settings, and the march appearance of each unit can be set independently.
For more functions of the Treasure Pavilion, please explore and experience in person.
Expansion of prop package:
Due to the opening of the treasure this time, many new props will be generated, so the upper limit of the package grid has been upgraded for free. Dozens of more props can be placed, and we plan to improve the expansion system of prop wrapping grids in the future. Let the masters know in real time how many spaces you have, how many spaces there are, and how many spaces you can expand each time.
After the maintenance on May 23, the "Wugu Feng Deng" festival activity will start. The content of the activity is as follows:
The activity time is from 10:00 p.m. on May 23, 2024 to 23:59 p.m. on June 5, 2024.
Activity 1: Golden Egg Gift
Golden and silver eggs appear from time to time during the activity. After defeating golden eggs or silver eggs, you can get a lot of rewards.
Activity 2: Lucky Turntable
During the event, you can get 3 turntable lottery tickets when you log in every day. You can turn to the orange fragment or even the divine fragment in the lucky turntable. The fragments of the gods that can be transferred to this lucky turntable are: Shen Tai Shi Ci fragments, Shen Lu Zhi fragments, and Shen Cao Ren fragments.
★★★★★★★ New out-of-print magic general - demon king
Devil's different positioning: control, assistance. Arms: Archers
The first skill: Loyalty: Active: The casting probability is 50%, causing a lot of strategic damage to the enemy 3 people, and has a chance to put the target into chaos for 2 rounds; at the same time, purify the friend 3 people (dispel the harmful state).
The second skill: Lifu Rising: Command: The first round is triggered, causing the three enemies to fall into a state of blockade, weakness (reduction of full damage), panic (loss of troops per round), and obtain the forbidden first aid and no healing effect; at the same time, all friends get an exciting effect (all damage increase), lasting for 2 rounds.
Disassembly skills: Regroup: Command: triggered in the 4th round, causing 3 enemies to panic (causing strategic damage in each round), while 3 friends get an immune chaos effect, lasting for 2 rounds.
Evaluation:
Comprehensive evaluation: Demon King Yi appeared gorgeously as a powerful control auxiliary general. Strong control ability, first-class auxiliary nature. The skill "Loyalty" can cause a lot of strategic damage to all the enemy, and at the same time give the target a state of chaos. At the same time, it will also clear the abnormal state of all friendly generals. The so-called control and assistance are correct. The second skill command skill is "Lifu to rise up", which blocks all enemy targets, is weak, and gives panic continuous damage effect. At the same time, it makes the enemy unable to recover its strength through strong recovery effects such as first aid and healing. Then give all the friendly generals to improve the full damage ability and ruthlessly strike the weak enemy. The disassembly skill "regrouping" is a magic skill in the later stage, which gives all the enemy's panic and continuous damage. At the same time, it gives all the friendly immune chaos effect, so that the friendly generals can stabilize the output and restore the state. This disassembly skill is a PK combat skill, which is a perfect match for a team with strong continuous combat ability. As a control auxiliary general, Demon King Yi can be matched with any lineup of generals to improve the overall strength of the army. It is highly recommended to make one. Recommended lineup: Demon Cao Hong + Magic Drama Talent + Demon King Yi (official with the demon general army, not to mention the strength), Demon King Yi + God Zhang Liao + Shen Wenpin (Demon God matching is also good, please study and match more combinations by yourself).
Activity 3: New holiday pub card bag
The powerful demon "Mo Guanping" entered the current festival pub card bag. The three generals, Shen Taishi Ci, Shen Lu Zhi and Shen Cao Ren, appeared in the pub card bag again after a long time. Don't miss the master if you want, you can draw it to your heart's content.
Activity 4: Redeem the reward
During the activity, there is a chance to drop text in every battle in the wild: Wu, Gu, Feng, Deng. Collecting these words can be exchanged for ingots, famous general treasure chests, lottery tickets, Putian Tongqing treasure chests, Taotu Tongqing treasure chests, magic general fragment boxes, dragon and phoenix crystal source treasure chests, rare treasure chests, and ordinary strengthening bags.
The new exploration order of the holiday redemption reward can be redeemed, and the exploration order can be used for treasure exploration.
Activity 5: Recharge Reward
If the cumulative recharge reaches a certain amount during the activity, you will receive a large number of rewards. This reward is mainly based on the out-of-print god general Shenma Dai. Those who did not draw Shenma Dai in the previous activity, or the owners who did not have enough fragments of Shenma Dai can get it in the recharge reward.
In addition, a number of enhanced elixirs have been added to the levels of 5,000, 10,000 and 20,000 of this cumulative recharge activity.
The reward in the level of 20,000 is replaced with the "Intreme Magic General Optional Box". After use, you can choose one of the 36 magic generals. You can't miss it.
Recharge rewards are richer.
Activity 6: Login Reward
During the activity, you can get 50 yuan, 50 noble points, 5 worship posts, 2 intermediate technology acceleration, 2 intermediate building acceleration, and 3 lottery tickets when you log in every day.
Activity 7: Double refund of recharge
During the activity, the setting of double ingots for the first purchase in the recharge interface will be reset, and players who have already purchased can enjoy double ingots again.
Activity 8: The single recharge activity is reset. In this period, the magic general's props in the daily single recharge level of 4998 are rewarded with "Demon King Fragments*200". The activity lasts for 14 days. Don't miss the new out-of-print demon general demon king!
At the same time, the 4998 grade reward has been upgraded, and the original "luxury gift package" has been upgraded to a "rich gift bag" (after use, you can choose from Orange Crystal*25, Phoenix Stone*300, Dragon Holy Stone*250, Magic Stone*250, Xuanhuang Stone*200, Colorful Stone*200.)
The God of the State of Wei and the God of the State of Wu replaced the box with the optional god general box*2, and replaced the Bicheng Dan with the Shendan treasure box (Bicheng Dan*2 and Feisheng Dan*400, choose one of them), and added the magical treasure box (7 kinds of star-watching stone, broken mirror stone, 8 kinds of war book, each with a huge amount).
Activity 9: Continuous recharge activity reset
Activity 10: A new cumulative consumption activity begins
The activity time is from 10:00 p.m. on May 23rd to 23:59 p.m. on June 5th. The god in the reward turns the fragments into fragments of the god Li Dian.
Activity 11: A new value-added discount activity begins
The discount props in this issue are: Shen Sima Yi fragments, aristocratic 7-day activation props, primary city protection orders, skill points, Lingxiao Hall, large physical potions, advanced recruitment orders, and honors.
Activity 12: God General Fragments Update of Merit Mall, Honor Mall and Tiger Fu Mall
Honor Mall updated to: Shen Lv Bu, Shen Guan Yu
Meritorious Service Mall updated to: God Zhang Fei, God Da Qiao
Hufu Mall has been updated to: Shen Huang Zhong, Shen Lu Xun
Activity 15: Adjust the content of the gift package purchased by recharge.
The fragments of the generals in the resource gift package from Monday to Saturday turned into fragments of Shen Tai Shi Ci.

notes.title: Maintenance notice on June 21
notes.content:
The whole server will be maintained from 10:00 to 14:00 on Wednesday, June 21. You can't log in to the game during the maintenance process. Please inform each other.
After the maintenance on June 21, the card bag of the current pub Dragon Boat Festival can be extracted: Shenbu Trainer, Shen Zhang Liao, Shen Meng Huo. Nirvana card bag can draw powerful demon generals: Mo Zhaoyu, Mo Guanping, the lord who has not been drawn before, can go to draw.
The new service S306 will be opened at 10 a.m. on Saturday, June 16.
After the maintenance on June 21, the game version will be updated to open a new system and new gameplay. The details are as follows:
Added 1: Battle Challenge Gameplay
You can switch to the battle scene through the main interface menu button "Battle" button to challenge. There is no limit on the number of challenges, and players with strength can challenge until the final level.
Battle rewards: You can get level rewards and battle mission rewards for each challenge victory. The battle gameplay can only be challenged once per season, the new season will be reset, and the enemy will become stronger according to the season. There are rich rewards for the battle, including the props of the new system, such as skin props, general equipment, stargazing system, props consumed by the soaring system, etc.
New 2: General Skin System
Generals can obtain different skin appearances, and can use skin props to activate to obtain generals's skin. After the general's skin is activated, you need to go to the general details page corresponding to the general's interface to wear it. After using the skin, the card image and body image of the general will change.
Activation attributes: Activate the skin to get the skin attributes (no need to use, as long as you activate, you can increase the attributes corresponding to the general of the same name).
Collect attributes: Activating a certain number of skins will also increase the speed attributes for all generals.
Star ascension attribute: After the general's skin is activated, you can upgrade it, and the star will continue to increase the attribute value.
Prop acquisition: Skin activation props and upgrade props can be obtained for free in the battle system. Of course, it can also be obtained in cumulative rewards and a large number of paid gift packages.
New 3: Equipment System
The generals have added equipment functions, and the general equipment paging is added to the general interface. After players get the equipment, they can equip the generals and add various attributes.
Ways to obtain equipment: challenge level rewards, equipment extraction in the production workshop in the main city, shopping mall purchase, and various paid activities.
New 4: Gemstone System
Gemstones can be used for equipment inlaying. After inlaying the equipment, the equipment can obtain gem attributes. After being worn by generals, the corresponding attributes can be added. The Iron Temple adds the function of gem synthesis, which can synthesize low-level gems of the same type into higher-level gems of the same type.
Ways to get gems: challenge level rewards, mall purchases.
Added 5: Stargazing, Ascension, Military Book System
The general has added its own strengthening function, and the consumption of the corresponding props can greatly improve all kinds of generals. You can go to the details page of the corresponding generals for operation.
Ways to obtain all kinds of enhanced props: battle challenge level rewards, production workshop extraction and acquisition, mall purchase.
New version optimization and adjustment:
Adjustment 1: The content of the gift package on the recharge interface is upgraded, the price remains unchanged, and the rewards are greatly increased.
Adjustment 2: The upper limit of each player's daily plundering resources has been limited, and now each character can plunder up to 20 million resources per day.
Adjustment 3: Increase equipment extraction and treasure extraction in the production workshop.
Adjustment 4: Iron Temple increases equipment decomposition and gem synthesis.
After the maintenance on June 21, the "day repair and night is short" will be opened. The content of the activity is as follows:

If you collect these words, you can exchange them for ingots, famous general treasure chests, lottery tickets, universal celebration treasure chests, Tutong celebration treasure chests, and magic general fragment boxes.

After using Zongzi, there is a chance to get a variety of high-value rewards, such as all kinds of military books, orange crystals (convertible orange packs), must-haven pieces (convertible must-haves), etc. It can only be redeemed during this event.
After using "Golden Zongzi", you can randomly get 10 god general fragments or magic general fragments. It can only be redeemed during this event.

Masters who have not drawn Shen Cao Ang in the previous activities, or who do not have enough fragments of Shen Cao Ang, can get it in the recharge reward.
In addition, several enhanced must-haves have been added to the 5,000, 10,000 and 20,000 levels of this cumulative recharge activity.
In order to cooperate with the opening of the new version of the new system functions, a number of orange crystal rewards have been added to the 1000, 3000, 5000, 10,000 and 20,000 levels of this cumulative recharge activity. Orange crystal can be exchanged for orange general equipment in the mall. In addition, the original ascension material package is replaced with an optional ascension material package, and you can choose from the archers, cavalry and infantry ascension package.
In the level of 20,000, the reward is replaced by "Supreme Magic General Optional Box". After use, you can choose one of the 24 magic generals. Don't miss it.

Activity 8: The single recharge activity is reset. In this daily single recharge reward, the original demon will replace the fragment reward with the supreme demon's optional box. Rewards are upgraded, and high-value prop rewards related to the new system are added, including: Longfeng Chengxiang treasure box (General Skin Activation Props), Soldier Book Treasure Box (General Soldier Book Enhancement Props), Luxury Gift Pack (Orange Crystal, Skin Props Optional Gift Pack).

notes.title: Update announcement on February 2
notes.content:
On Monday, January 30, S271-S282 will clean up inactive accounts irregularly, each time lasting 10-20 minutes. Inactive accounts refer to: 1. Not occupying land above level 10. 2. Not online for three consecutive days. 3. No recharging has been performed. If the above three points are met at the same time, the account is inactive and will be cleared.

The full service will be maintained from 10:00 to 14:00 on Thursday, February 2. After the maintenance, the "Happy New Year" activity will end and the new activity "Warm Spring" will be officially launched. S271-S279 enters the third season and S280-S282 enters the second season. Please refer to the season description in the general trend of the world for the specific contents of the season. Attention of the relevant masters of this season's settlement: the roulette award of the last activity will be distributed to your mailbox at 0:00 on February 2. If you don't go to the mailbox before the maintenance on February 2, the season settlement will empty the mailbox. Please try to get rewards before maintenance. ★★★★★★★ The new out-of-print magic general - Magic Zhao Yu

Devil Zhao woman positioning: kitchen knife output core auxiliary. Branch: cavalry

The first skill: the will of the Virgin: active: the probability of casting is 50%, which immediately causes a large amount of attack damage to the enemy's three people, and increases the attack, hit and rage of the enemy's three people, lasting for 2 rounds.

The second skill: Elephant Leg Hurricane: Command: Triggered in the third round, it will make three enemies fall into a dizzy state for one round, and reduce the attack, defense and dodge of the target, and obtain the bleeding effect, lasting for three rounds.

Detachable skill: Gathering of heroes: command: trigger in the first round, make yourself obtain the fearless effect (reduce the total damage received) and the uplifting effect (increase the total damage), and increase the critical hit for 2 rounds (increase the skill level can increase the number of continuous rounds, and the highest level can last for 5 rounds).

Evaluation:

Comprehensive evaluation: As an assistant, Magic Zhao Yu can add attack, hit, rage and other attributes to all friends, which perfectly matches the kitchen knife generals. With the command skill triggered in the third round, you can better counter attack the enemy. Vertigo all the enemy for one round, reduce all the enemy's attack, defense and dodge at the same time, and let the enemy's generals fall into a state of bloodshed. After one move, two moves, the situation can form a major reversal. As a kind of post-emptive assistance, friendly generals can effectively combat and relieve pressure. The disassembling skill "gathering of heroes" is the best magic skill of the kitchen knife generals, which can greatly increase the output limit of the kitchen knife generals. It is strongly recommended that you make one. Recommended lineup: Devil Lv Bu+Devil Sun Zan+Devil Zhao Nu (the strength of the official army is needless to say), Devil Zhao Nu+Divine Wenchou+Divine Lv Bu.
